mapper.select: SELECT orders.*, order_items.*, users.username FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id JOIN products ON products.product_id = order_items.product_id JOIN users ON orders.user_id = users.user_id WHERE username = #{username} AND orders.order_status = 'PENDING';
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id) VALUES (SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = #{username});
INSERT INTO order_items(order_id, product_id, purchase_price, quantity) VALUES(#{item.orderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.purchasePrice}, #{item.quantity});
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM order_items WHERE order_id = (SELECT order_id FROM orders JOIN users ON orders.user_id WHERE username = #{username} AND status = 'PENDING') AND product_id = #{item.productId};
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET order_status = #{status} WHERE order_id = #{orderId};
mapper.select: SELECT users.username, purchased_items.product_id, products.product_name, products.product_type FROM purchased_items JOIN users ON purchased_items.user_id = users.user_id JOIN products ON purchased_items.product_id = products.product_id WHERE username = #{username} AND products.product_type in ('GAME', 'DLC');
